integrity: The exact value is proved analytically by classifying all Birkhoff--James orthogonal unit pairs through supporting functionals. Numerical bisection and branch sampling in the checker are diagnostic only and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats one real two-dimensional mixed Euclidean--taxicab norm and the unweighted orthogonal James constant.
The result does not compute weighted or approximate-Birkhoff profiles or higher-dimensional analogues.
The literature comparison is extensive but cannot exclude an obscure or poorly indexed independent exact derivation.
title: Exact orthogonal James constant of a mixed Euclidean–taxicab Banach plane
